name: Euskirchen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Euskirchen (a yellow city gate with flanking towers on red).
history: Municipal flag of Euskirchen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Euskirchen arms — city gate with towers on red
